The '''Pestoriv system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Pestoriv Conferences]] that were held at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pestoriv system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-12.<ref name="TEA" />
